caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with an octagonal body, embellished with decorative patterns along the upper and lower borders. The teapot has a long, straight spout extending to the right, and an intricately curved handle on the left, shaded in a much darker tone than the rest of the drawing, suggesting a different material or color. The lid of the teapot is round, topped with a knob handle, and features subtle shading to indicate depth. The central panel on the side of the teapot displays an ornate crest or monogram within a shield-like frame. The teapot stands on four short, curved legs and is positioned on a shallow stand or tray that supports its base. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on a light beige background with areas of subtle discoloration near the edges.
title: Silver Teapot and Tray
